scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms-builder typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/dms typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/dms/frontend-vue typecheck:tests && antelopejs-tsc --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir packages/dms/playground run -s types:prepare && oxlint && node packages/dms/playground/checks/raw-sources.cjs && pnpm --dir packages/dms/playground run -s lint:client && pnpm run deps && pnpm --dir packages/dms/frontend-vue lint
scripts.knip: pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms knip && pnpm --dir packages/interface-dms-builder knip && pnpm --dir packages/dms knip
scripts.prepare: if [ -e .git ] && command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v lefthook >/dev/null 2>&1 && GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. lefthook install; fi
